sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from VR-700_MI.pdf (sha256 fb19b091ab02021f7dacf4cf6a5c176584290babb09e0e0fe82988498c08e7a0). Model ID 00 00 42, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Cover metadata: the map's source block reads model null, date "Version:", version "VR-700" (the importer took the cover's label column for its value column). The document is VR-700 MIDI Implementation version 1.00, dated Jan. 1, 2010 (cover, p1; Implementation Chart, p11).

Favorite Ensemble (Ensemble: 01) is at 10 00 20 00 and (Ensemble: 02) at 10 00 21 32: the second follows the first at its Total Size (00 00 01 32), not on a 00 01 00 boundary (p7). The offset table also prints a bare "Favorite Ensemble" at 00 20 00, the same address as Ensemble 01; it is not laid out a second time.

Keyboard Transpose (Favorite Common 00 04, 58-69), Rotary Network Freq, Rotary Com Filter and EQ Bass/Middle/Treble Gain (Favorite ToneWheel 00 26-00 2C, 59-69) are printed with a 4-bit layout (0000 aaaa) that cannot carry their own ranges; they are sent as the full byte their range needs.
System Equalizer's frequency lists print "200.250" for "200, 250" (p8), so they count 30 labels for 31 values and stay numbers 0-30 with the manual's list as their description.
The two Mid bands of the System Equalizer are printed with the same names (EQ Mid Frequency/Gain/Q at 00 06-00 08 and 00 09-00 0B); they are numbered 1 and 2 in printed order.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: the harmonic bars (CC 70-78), rotary speed/brake and wheel brake (CC 80-82) and the other Control Changes (p1-3, p5-6) are not mapped yet
coverage.tones: none in the map: the two Ensemble parts select their tones by bank and program number (Tone Bank Select MSB/LSB, Tone Program Change# in each Favorite Ensemble block; the tone list is p1); the tones have no parameters in the MIDI Implementation, and the organ is the ToneWheel and ToneWheel Modify blocks
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: the Ensemble MFX parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on MFX Type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list. The reverb's 4-nibble slots are all printed "(reserved)" and are not laid out
